FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE IBBAGAMUWA PRADESHIYA SABHAUNDER SECTION 66A(1) (a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member in 16 - Hunupola of Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason ofResignation;

And whereas the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political party to which Yapa MudiyanselageJagath Manjula Yapa the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) (a) of the aforesaid ordinance, todecide upon the member of that 16 - Hunupola of Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and is notdisqualified under Section 9 of the local authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared elected as a member withina period of thirty (30) days ;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision to nominateWijesinghe Mudiyanselage Wijekoon Banda to fill such vacancy ;

Now therefore I, Gamalathge Dilip Nishantha, Returning Officer of the Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha, acting interms of Section 66A(1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that WijesingheMudiyanselage Wijekoon Banda was elected as the member of the 16 - Hunupola of Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha.
GAMALATHGE DILIP NISHANTHA,Returning Officer,Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha.
